halt.note: For real use ($10 in): when total equity (cash + open positions, marked to live prices) touches $5.00, every position is closed and the bot latches a halt until you run 'python run.py resume'. A floor check only runs when the loop runs -- it is a guard rail, not a guarantee; exchange-side stop orders and a dead man's switch are still required for live trading. Paper accounts smaller than 2x the floor use paper_floor_pct instead so the guard is testable at $1 scale.

analyst.note: Decision layer, veto-only. provider 'auto' tries keys in order: Jev (TYPESAFE_API_KEY, ~$0.042/M input tokens), openai-decisions (OPENAI_API_KEY, gpt-6-luna, $0.10/M), then chat providers: nebius, openai, anthropic, gemini, deepseek, groq, mistral, together, xai, openrouter, zai, ollama (OLLAMA_ENABLED=1), custom (ANALYST_BASE_URL+ANALYST_API_KEY+ANALYST_MODEL = any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). mode 'gate' lets the analyst veto entries only; it can never raise size, leverage, or trade count. The daily budget cap makes any credit last for months.

testnet.note: Rung 2 of the ladder: REAL signed orders, MOCK money on Hyperliquid testnet. Requires: 1) pip install hyperliquid-python-sdk, 2) a TESTNET API wallet key: setx BLACKHORSE_TESTNET_KEY "..." (create at app.hyperliquid-testnet.xyz -> API; trade-only, cannot withdraw), 3) enabled=true, then 'python run.py testnet'. Never put a mainnet key here. If your network cannot reach api.hyperliquid-testnet.xyz, doctor will show it -- stay in paper mode until it can.

live.note: Real-money trading is intentionally locked off. Do not enable until the paper bot shows positive expectancy over several weeks, India access/tax questions are cleared with a qualified adviser, and a testnet run with a trade-only API wallet (can trade, cannot withdraw) succeeds. Perps have a ~$10 minimum order size. Even with enabled=true, the engine refuses to run unless acknowledgement is EXACTLY 'I-ACCEPT-REAL-MONEY-RISK' -- same pattern as beebots' LIVE_ACK.

mtf.note: Multi-timeframe gate: block entries when the higher timeframe EMA trend is against the trade
